verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: Eis a palavra que da parte de Jeová veio a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: שִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את וְדִבַּרְתָּם֙ אֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zōṯ wə·ḏib·bar·tām ’el- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah . . . and the residents of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Ouvi as palavras desta aliança e fala aos homens de Judá e aos habitantes de Jerusalém;

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָר֣וּר הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמַ֔ע אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַבְּרִ֥ית הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer lō yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: You must tell them that . . . this is what the LORD the God of Israel says Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant
verses.literalPt: dize-lhes: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Maldito seja o homem que não ouvir as palavras desta aliança,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֡ם בְּי֣וֹם הוֹצִיאִֽי־ אוֹתָ֣ם מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַיִם֩ מִכּ֨וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר שִׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֲצַוֶּ֖ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·yō·wm hō·w·ṣî·’î- ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim mik·kūr hab·bar·zel lê·mōr šim·‘ū ḇə·qō·w·lî wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·w·ṯām kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem lî lə·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt out of the iron furnace saying Obey Me . . . and do everything I command you and you will be My people and I will be your God
verses.literalPt: a qual ordenei a vossos pais no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, da fornalha de ferro, dizendo: Obedecei à minha voz e fazei segundo tudo quanto vos ordeno; assim, vós sereis o meu povo, e eu serei o vosso Deus;

verses.original: לְמַעַן֩ הָקִ֨ים אֶת־ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֜ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לָתֵ֤ת לָהֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֛ב וּדְבַ֖שׁ כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאַ֥עַן וָאֹמַ֖ר אָמֵ֥ן׀ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- haš·šə·ḇū·‘āh ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš kay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·’a·‘an wā·’ō·mar ’ā·mên Yah·weh
verses.literal: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers to give them . . . a land flowing with milk and honey as it is to this day . . . Amen LORD I answered . . .
verses.literalPt: para que eu estabeleça o juramento que jurei a vossos pais, de lhes dar uma terra que manasse leite e mel, como é no dia de hoje. Então, respondi e disse: Amém, Jeová!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קְרָ֨א אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְחֻצ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שִׁמְע֗וּ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay qə·rā ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr šim·‘ū ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zōṯ wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem saying Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out
verses.literalPt: Disse-me Jeová: Proclama todas estas palavras nas cidades de Judá e nas ruas de Jerusalém, dizendo: Ouvi as palavras desta aliança e observai-as.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָעֵ֨ד הַעִדֹ֜תִי בַּאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיוֹם֩ הַעֲלוֹתִ֨י אוֹתָ֜ם מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וְעַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְהָעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר שִׁמְע֖וּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî hā·‘êḏ ha·‘i·ḏō·ṯî ba·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·yō·wm ha·‘ă·lō·w·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh haš·kêm wə·hā·‘êḏ lê·mōr šim·‘ū bə·qō·w·lî
verses.literal: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today . . . I strongly warned them . . . again and again . . . saying Obey My voice
verses.literalPt: Pois com instância protestei a vossos pais no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito até o dia de hoje, levantando-me cedo e protestando: Obedecei à minha voz.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֔ם וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אִ֕ישׁ בִּשְׁרִיר֖וּת לִבָּ֣ם הָרָ֑ע וָאָבִ֨יא עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֧י הַבְּרִית־ הַזֹּ֛את אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּ֥יתִי לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א עָשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū wə·lō- hiṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nām way·yê·lə·ḵū ’îš biš·rî·rūṯ lib·bām hā·rā‘ wā·’ā·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ- haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wî·ṯî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ wə·lō ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, não obedeceram, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas andaram, cada um, na obstinação do seu mau coração; portanto, fiz vir sobre eles todas as palavras desta aliança, as quais lhes ordenei que observassem, porém não as observaram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י נִֽמְצָא־ קֶ֙שֶׁר֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy nim·ṣā- qe·šer bə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And the LORD told me There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Disse-me mais Jeová: Uma conspiração se achou entre os homens de Judá e entre os habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: שָׁ֩בוּ֩ עַל־ עֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתָ֜ם הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵֽאֲנוּ֙ לִשְׁמ֣וֹעַ אֶת־ דְּבָרַ֔י וְהֵ֣מָּה הָלְכ֗וּ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָ֑ם הֵפֵ֤רוּ בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֕י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: šā·ḇū ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nōṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām hā·ri·šō·nîm ’ă·šer mê·’ă·nū liš·mō·w·a‘ ’eṯ- də·ḇā·ray wə·hêm·māh hā·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām hê·p̄ê·rū ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’ă·šer kā·rat·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers . . . who refused to obey My words They have followed . . . other gods to serve them The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers
verses.literalPt: Tornaram às iniquidades de seus pais, que recusaram ouvir as minhas palavras; e já se foram após outros deuses, para os servir; a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá quebraram a minha aliança, que fiz com seus pais.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא אֲלֵיהֶם֙ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יוּכְל֖וּ לָצֵ֣את מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְזָעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî mê·ḇî ’ă·lê·hem rā·‘āh ’ă·šer lō- yū·ḵə·lū lā·ṣêṯ mim·men·nāh wə·zā·‘ă·qū ’ê·lay wə·lō ’eš·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD . . . says I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot . . . escape . . . They will cry out to Me but I will not listen to them
verses.literalPt: Por isso, assim diz Jeová: Eis que vou trazer sobre eles calamidades, de que não poderão escapar; clamarão a mim, porém não os escutarei.

verses.original: וְהָֽלְכ֞וּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְיֹשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְזָֽעֲקוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם מְקַטְּרִ֖ים לָהֶ֑ם וְהוֹשֵׁ֛עַ לֹֽא־ יוֹשִׁ֥יעוּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֥ת רָעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·lə·ḵū ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·zā·‘ă·qū ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer hêm mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm lā·hem wə·hō·wō·šê·a‘ lō- yō·wō·šî·‘ū lā·hem bə·‘êṯ rā·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense but these gods certainly will not save . . . them in their time of disaster
verses.literalPt: Então, irão as cidades de Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém e clamaram aos deuses aos quais queimarão incenso; mas estes não salvarão de maneira alguma no tempo da sua aflição.

verses.original: כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔יךָ הָי֥וּ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמִסְפַּ֞ר חֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם שַׂמְתֶּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹת֙ לַבֹּ֔שֶׁת מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְקַטֵּ֥ר לַבָּֽעַל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî mis·par ‘ā·re·ḵā hā·yū ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mis·par ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim śam·tem miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ lab·bō·šeṯ miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ lə·qaṭ·ṭêr lab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities O Judah the altars of shame you have set up the altars to burn incense to Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Pois, segundo o número das tuas cidades, são os teus deuses, ó Judá; e, segundo o número das ruas de Jerusalém, tendes erigido altares a uma coisa vergonhosa, altares para queimardes incenso a Baal.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה אַל־ תִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ בְּעַד־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַל־ תִּשָּׂ֥א בַעֲדָ֖ם רִנָּ֣ה וּתְפִלָּ֑ה כִּ֣י אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֗עַ בְּעֵ֛ת קָרְאָ֥ם אֵלַ֖י בְּעַ֥ד רָעָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’al- tiṯ·pal·lêl bə·‘aḏ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·’al- tiś·śā ḇa·‘ă·ḏām rin·nāh ū·ṯə·p̄il·lāh kî ’ê·nen·nî šō·mê·a‘ bə·‘êṯ qā·rə·’ām ’ê·lay bə·‘aḏ rā·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: As for you do not pray for these people Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf for I will not be listening when they call out to Me . . . in their time of disaster
verses.literalPt: Portanto, não ores tu por este povo, nem por eles levantes clamor nem oração; porque eu não os ouvirei no tempo em que clamarem a mim por causa da sua aflição.

verses.original: מֶ֣ה לִֽידִידִ֞י בְּבֵיתִ֗י עֲשׂוֹתָ֤הּ הַֽמְזִמָּ֙תָה֙ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים וּבְשַׂר־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יַעַבְר֣וּ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ כִּ֥י רָעָתֵ֖כִי אָ֥ז תַּעֲלֹֽזִי׃
verses.transliteration: meh lî·ḏî·ḏî bə·ḇê·ṯî ‘ă·śō·w·ṯāh ham·zim·mā·ṯāh hā·rab·bîm ū·ḇə·śar- qō·ḏeš ya·‘aḇ·rū mê·‘ā·lā·yiḵ kî rā·‘ā·ṯê·ḵî ’āz ta·‘ă·lō·zî
verses.literal: What right has My beloved in My house having carried out so many evil schemes Can consecrated meat avert your doom When you are wicked then you rejoice
verses.literalPt: Que tem a minha amada a fazer na minha casa, visto que leva a efeito maus desígnios? Porventura, votos e carne santa poderão afastar de ti o mal? Ou por estes poderás escapar.

verses.original: זַ֤יִת רַֽעֲנָן֙ יְפֵ֣ה פְרִי־ תֹ֔אַר קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֵ֑ךְ לְק֣וֹל׀ הֲמוּלָּ֣ה גְדֹלָ֗ה הִצִּ֥ית אֵשׁ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ וְרָע֖וּ דָּלִיּוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: za·yiṯ ra·‘ă·nān yə·p̄êh p̄ə·rî- ṯō·’ar qā·rā Yah·weh šə·mêḵ lə·qō·wl hă·mūl·lāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh hiṣ·ṣîṯ ’êš ‘ā·le·hā wə·rā·‘ū dā·lî·yō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree beautiful with well-formed fruit But with a mighty roar . . . He will set it on fire . . . . . . and its branches will be consumed
verses.literalPt: Jeová te pôs o nome de oliveira verde, formosa de belos frutos; mas, ao som dum grande tumulto, acendeu fogo nessa árvore, e os seus ramos são quebrados.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ הַנּוֹטֵ֣עַ אוֹתָ֔ךְ דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלַ֖יִךְ רָעָ֑ה בִּ֠גְלַל רָעַ֨ת בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם לְהַכְעִסֵ֖נִי לְקַטֵּ֥ר לַבָּֽעַל׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ han·nō·w·ṭê·a‘ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ dib·ber ‘ā·la·yiḵ rā·‘āh biḡ·lal rā·‘aṯ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lā·hem lə·haḵ·‘i·sê·nî lə·qaṭ·ṭêr lab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts who planted you has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves . . . provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová dos Exércitos, que te plantou, acaba de pronunciar contra ti calamidades, por causa dos males da casa de Israel e da casa de Judá, que da sua parte fizeram, queimando incenso a Baal, para me provocarem à ira.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֥ה הֽוֹדִיעַ֖נִי וָֽאֵדָ֑עָה אָ֖ז הִרְאִיתַ֥נִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·w·ḏî·‘a·nî wā·’ê·ḏā·‘āh ’āz hir·’î·ṯa·nî ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: And the LORD informed me so I knew Then You showed me their deeds
verses.literalPt: Jeová me fez saber, e eu o soube; então, me mostraste os feitos deles.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֕י כְּכֶ֥בֶשׂ אַלּ֖וּף יוּבַ֣ל לִטְב֑וֹחַ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֜עְתִּי כִּֽי־ עָלַ֣י׀ חָשְׁב֣וּ מַחֲשָׁב֗וֹת נַשְׁחִ֨יתָה עֵ֤ץ בְּלַחְמוֹ֙ וְנִכְרְתֶ֙נּוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וּשְׁמ֖וֹ לֹֽא־ יִזָּכֵ֥ר עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî kə·ḵe·ḇeś ’al·lūp̄ yū·ḇal liṭ·ḇō·w·aḥ wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ‘ā·lay ḥā·šə·ḇū ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ naš·ḥî·ṯāh ‘êṣ bə·laḥ·mōw wə·niḵ·rə·ṯen·nū mê·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm ū·šə·mōw lō- yiz·zā·ḵêr ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter I did not know that they had plotted . . . against me Let us destroy the tree with its fruit let us cut him off from the land of the living that his name may be remembered no more
verses.literalPt: Mas eu era como um manso cordeiro que é levado ao matadouro; eu não soube que haviam formado contra mim desígnios, dizendo: Destruamos a árvore juntamente com o seu fruto e exterminemo-lo da terra dos viventes, para que não seja lembrado mais o seu nome.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שֹׁפֵ֣ט צֶ֔דֶק בֹּחֵ֥ן כְּלָי֖וֹת וָלֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְךָ֙ מֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־ רִיבִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šō·p̄êṭ ṣe·ḏeq bō·ḥên kə·lā·yō·wṯ wā·lêḇ ’er·’eh niq·mā·ṯə·ḵā mê·hem kî ’ê·le·ḵā gil·lî·ṯî ’eṯ- rî·ḇî
verses.literal: O LORD of Hosts who judges righteously who examines the heart and mind let me see Your vengeance upon them for to You I have committed my cause
verses.literalPt: Porém tu, Jeová dos Exércitos, que julgas retamente, que provas os rins e o coração, permite que eu veja a vingança que tomarás deles; porque a ti revelei a minha causa.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ עַל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת הַֽמְבַקְשִׁ֥ים אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תָמ֖וּת בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- ’an·šê ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ ham·ḇaq·šîm ’eṯ- nap̄·šə·ḵā lê·mōr lō ṯin·nā·ḇê bə·šêm Yah·weh wə·lō ṯā·mūṯ bə·yā·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD . . . or you will die by our hand
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz Jeová acerca dos homens de Anatote, os quais procuram tirar-te a vida, dizendo: Não profetizarás em nome de Jeová, para que não morras às nossas mãos;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י פֹקֵ֖ד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הַבַּֽחוּרִים֙ יָמֻ֣תוּ בַחֶ֔רֶב בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וּבְנ֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם יָמֻ֖תוּ בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hin·nî p̄ō·qêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem hab·ba·ḥū·rîm yā·mu·ṯū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ bə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem yā·mu·ṯū bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: So this is what the LORD of Hosts . . . says I will punish them . . . Their young men will die by the sword their sons and daughters by famine
verses.literalPt: por isso, assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos: Eis que os castigarei; os mancebos morrerão à espada, seus filhos e suas filhas morrerão de fome,

verses.original: וּשְׁאֵרִ֕ית לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אָבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲנָת֖וֹת שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ê·rîṯ lō ṯih·yeh lā·hem kî- ’ā·ḇî rā·‘āh ’el- ’an·šê ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ šə·naṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām
verses.literal: There will be no remnant for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment
verses.literalPt: e não lhes ficará um resto, pois farei vir calamidades sobre os homens de Anatote, a saber, o ano de serem eles visitados.
